name: Milcah
bio: Milcah is the daughter of Haran and sister of Lot, who later married her uncle Nahor (Genesis 11:29). Scripture says little about her own life, but her family line matters a great deal — her descendants through Nahor include Rebekah, who would become Isaac's wife (Genesis 22:20-23; 24), bringing Milcah's bloodline directly into Abraham's covenant family.
